body:
[A590] REVIEW READY (round 2, PR #722)
Commit: c0cba330fd485e52fcb90d5ccc69169edf9f0c2b (local commits on branch `640-m5`, not pushed; three new commits on `988ec7f6`, no rebase or amend)
Changed:
- `5747be31`: R599-1 RES-1. `hdl/common/csr/milan_csr.sv:1066-1068` uses the exact RES-1 text. The change is comment-only.
- `80e41fc1`, all in `docs/design/MARK_II_AREA_PLAN.md`:
  - R599-1-F1: `:1023-1024` gives each per-stream figure with its scope, in R599-1's text, and makes no reproduction claim.
  - R598-1-S1: `:1027` reads "At M5's measured 121, the partial-central scenario becomes about 38,436, 396 over 38,040, pending the week-4 re-measure (D8)."
  - R599-1 RES-2: `:538` reads "M5 saved 121 LUTs routed".
- `c0cba330`: reflows the same comment banner. The file keeps its 3,225 lines, so every line cited at `988ec7f6` is unchanged.
- R598-1-F1 = R599-1-F2: the PR body attribution (in the PR-BODY.md for the manager to apply) and HANDOFF sections 5 and 7 now give disjoint parts:
  - `csr` -121 (credited);
  - the processor wrapper -342, nearly all of it in `u_pp` (-344, nested inside the wrapper, not added);
  - about -227 in other untouched blocks.
  These sum to -690. The figures come from the route gate's own sub-block output for the M5 route.
- R599-1 RES-3: the PR body's `tb/verilator/csr/` row now says "byte for byte apart from the module name".
- R599-1-S1 (alternate placement directives) is optional and was not run, because this round runs no route.
Validation, at `c0cba330` on a clean tree. Each gate was run unpiped and each returned rc 0:
- Markdown gates, in the docs virtualenv with the pinned renderer:
  - `python3 scripts/docs_check.py`, also with `GIT_DIR=/dev/null`
  - `python3 scripts/check_em_dash.py --base e8454e27` (0 findings over 68 added lines) and `--selftest`
  - `python3 scripts/check_doc_style.py` and `--selftest`
  - `python3 scripts/check_gptp_docs.py` and `--selftest`
  - `python3 scripts/gen_toc.py --selftest`, `--verify-anchors` and `--check`
  - `python3 scripts/check_doc_paths.py`
  - `python3 docs/traceability/gen_module_matrix.py --check`
- Gates for the touched RTL file, under CPython 3.12.3:
  - `check_sv_idiom.py`
  - `check_hygiene.py --check`
  - `measure_naming.py --check`
  - `measure_fail_fast.py --check`
  - `check_todo_ownership.py`
  - `measure_test_evidence.py --check`
  - `check_port_contracts.py`
  - `check_rtl_source_lists.py`
  - `lint_rtl.py --check` (90 <= 90, pinned Verilator 5.050)
  - `git diff --check e8454e27 HEAD`
- `MAKEFLAGS=w make -C tb/verilator/csr` under GNU make 4.3:
  - lock1: 5/5, 28,167 random-traffic reads;
  - lock8: 5/5, 22,750 reads;
  - 0 mismatching cycles;
  - `lock_mutants.py`: 8/8.
  These figures equal round 1.
- `git diff 988ec7f6 HEAD -- hdl` touches only `//!` comment lines.
- `git diff 1abe18eb HEAD -- syn sw configs` is empty.
Acceptance criteria: unchanged from round 1. The routed RTL logic is the head's logic. Every item in the round 2 assignment is done, except the optional S1.
Open risks/questions: the saving is below the estimate. The cumulative tables keep 600 until the week-4 re-measure, and the ledger now states the partial-central consequence. That remains a manager decision. HANDOFF section 8 and the PR-BODY "Round 2" section have the details.
